body.input: Which fintech companies opened an office in Finland in 2026?

response.content:
Based on available information covering Nordic fintech developments in 2026, the following companies expanded their presence into Finland during 2026:

- **Software Mind** — Partnered with Helsinki Fintech Farm in October 2026 to grow its presence in the Nordic financial sector, specifically targeting Finland.

- **Monthio** — The Danish fintech expanded into the Finnish credit market in 2026.

- **Salt Edge** — Partnered with NoCFO to bring Pay by Bank services to entrepreneurs in Finland (and Germany) in early 2026.

- **Klarna** — Joined Paytrail in Finland, further expanding its reach through local Finnish infrastructure in 2026.

It is worth noting that these expansions were reported as market-entry partnerships or service launches rather than all necessarily involving the opening of a physical office. A "Swedish open banking vendor" was also reported to have opened an office in Finland (noted in Nordic Fintech Highlights from 2024, not confirmed as 2026). No comprehensive registry of all fintech office openings in Finland during 2026 is available, so additional companies may have established offices without broad media coverage.

explainability.content: Software Mind partnered with Helsinki Fintech Farm in October 2026, indicating its expansion into Finland that year.
Monthio was reported to expand into the Finnish credit market in 2026, showing its entry into Finland that year.
Salt Edge partnered with NoCFO to bring Pay by Bank services to entrepreneurs in Finland in early 2026, demonstrating its market presence in Finland that year.
Klarna joined Paytrail in Finland in 2026, indicating its expansion into the Finnish market that year.
